courses.title: Prayer in Motion: Monthly Online Somatic Dance Ceremony
courses.description: A 90-minute live online gathering held each month, in which Amy leads somatic dance, breathwork, movement mantras and chakra activation as a group ritual. No dance experience is needed; the focus is on reconnecting with the body, ancestral movement and community.

flags: Prayer in Motion: the page promises to 'release energetic blockages and trauma from the body' and speaks of 'the healing power of moving in community'; emotional and energy-healing wording, no medical claim, so kept under the 12 Nov rule.
